blocks.text: BALINGASAG, Misamis Oriental — Can you save the planet by tearing it apart? Mindanao’s environmental coalition and indigenous defenders are asking this question as they reject the narrative that aggressive mining is a “necessary evil” for the global transition to clean energy. Panalipod People’s Coalition (PPC) issued a sharp pushback on Monday against recent claims by lawyer Mike Toledo, chairman of the Chamber of Mines of the Philippines, who championed mining as “indispensable” in the fight against climate change due to the high demand for transition minerals like nickel and copper.
